messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — bringing up GemmaX-3B int8 on the dedicated pool; initial smoke shows embedding drift vs hosted baseline. Suspect tokenizer->vocab mapping offset from the conversion step.
matt: can you paste a tiny repro?
ana: repro below — converted tokenizer maps 'Ġthe' -> 502 instead of 503, so embedding table lookup is off by one for ~120 tokens.
```
# hosted tokenizer ids: [11, 345, 503, 22]
# local converted ids: [11, 345, 502, 22]
# text: "In the beginning"
```
li: that screams special-token insertion/offset bug in the conversion script — maybe pad or sentinel missing.
matt: common quick check: compare vocab size and index of '<pad>' '<unk>' '<s>' '</s>' across both tokenizers.
sasha: two remediation paths:
- hotfix: shift embedding indices by +1 for converted tokenizer (fast but risky)
- proper fix: produce mapping.json during conversion and remap embedding rows to preserve semantics
priyanka: note from quant evals: when we applied the quick shift hack the codegen exact-match dropped ~3.7%. Could be kv-cache aliasing making it worse under int8.
ana: I reran deterministic prompts after shift-hack; logits for some deterministic tokens regressed slightly.
li: kv-cache aliasing is the silent killer: if token ids change, cache keys stored in earlier positions point to wrong vectors -> attention attends to wrong slots.
matt: quick diagnostic snippet to compare caches:
```
# pseudo
orig = model.forward(tokens)
orig_cache = model.kv_cache.copy()
# re-tokenize with converted tokenizer -> forward
new = model.forward(tokens_converted)
new_cache = model.kv_cache
# compare slotwise cosine(orig_cache[i], new_cache[i])
```
ana: did that — affected slots have cosine ~0.12 vs ~0.99 for untouched slots.
sasha: low-level fix: preserve special token ordering in conversion, write mapping.json, then remap embedding rows by mapping.json rather than shifting indices.
priyanka: agree. Add onboarding tests: roundtrip assert decode(tokenize(text)) identical, and embedding consistency test on seed corpus.
matt: suggested unit: for 256 seed sentences assert avg cosine(emb_host, emb_converted) > 0.995.
ana: also observed regressions only after int8 quant + rotary scale tweak. Could be rotary mismatch.
li: GemmaX uses headwise rotary scale variant; if we load weights assuming shared rotary params, angle wrapping and scaling diverge -> generation drift.
sasha: checklist for model bring-up:
1) tokenizer mapping.json with special token offsets and checksums
2) remap embedding matrix using mapping.json, verify shapes
3) kv-cache unit test for slot alignment and cosine thresholds
4) rotary config verification (headwise vs shared) + tiny generation parity check
5) run quant smoke (int8) + full eval suite
priyanka: I'll add tests to the onboarding PR and a Canary route (1%) with automatic fallback if eval delta > threshold.
ana: deploying that plan. FYI deploy-bot CI for the quant build failed earlier; logs attached.
deploy-bot: build-quant/GemmaX-3B-int8 failed — OOM during fast-kernel compile on rtx-a6000, retrying in 10m.
matt: tag eng-infra if compile OOM persists; we may need a larger compile worker or lower compile concurrency.
li: for short-term unblock we can keep the shift-hack behind a runtime flag to unblock dev testing, but do NOT promote to dedicated without mapping.json remap.
sasha: PR description should call out potential cache aliasing and quant sensitivity.
ana: will open the PR with mapping.json, unit tests, seed eval results, and the canary plan. Linking this thread in the PR. :rocket:
